faq.a: Clippers have a tiny motor that moves the blades very fast. That makes the buzz. They are loud but they do not hurt.

faq.q: What can I say at the hairdresser?
faq.a: You can say, Can you use scissors, please? or Can we have a short pause? or Please tell me before you start.

Tell me about Ask for a pause

faq.q: Why does my neck feel itchy?
faq.a: Tiny cut hairs land on your skin. A soft brush or a cape helps. They wash away later.
Hairdressers want you to feel comfy and look good. They are glad when you tell them what helps.
asks: Will they be cross if I ask?

faq.q: What helps me get ready for a haircut?
faq.a: Visit the shop first to look around, watch someone else, or bring ear defenders. A grown-up you trust can help.

facts: Hair does not have feeling nerves, so cutting it does not hurt.
Electric hair clippers have blades that move side to side very quickly.
